jobLeads.title: Backend Developer
jobLeads.japanese: No Japanese required; N2+ is optional.
jobLeads.fit: Direct Go match. Production services, relational design and distributed-system trade-offs. Three office days/week.

jobLeads.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go), Communication Platform Department, PPD, Tokyo
jobLeads.japanese: No Japanese required; business English (TOEIC 700 equivalent).
jobLeads.fit: 6+ years developing and operating medium/large web services. Strong Go, AWS, SQL, architecture and mentoring required. Exactly at the tenure floor.

jobLeads.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Web Dev) — Access Control
jobLeads.japanese: No Japanese required; English B2+ (e.g. TOEIC 785+).
jobLeads.fit: Requires 5+ years specifically in production Python web apps, plus cloud and mentoring. Mixed Go/Python tenure may not meet that hard floor. Pay includes conditional English/office-attendance allowances.

jobLeads.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend/Infrastructure) — Secure Transfer
jobLeads.fit: Requires 3+ years production Python plus substantial Kubernetes, Terraform and mission-critical AWS ownership. Same allowance caveat. Not an app-coding-only job.

jobLeads.title: Backend Engineer
jobLeads.japanese: No Japanese required; business English is sufficient.
jobLeads.fit: Minato-ku. Non-Java Go/Python engineers explicitly accepted; 4+ year tier, distributed cache/concurrency skills. Professional AI-development-tool use required. Production stack is mainly Java/Kotlin/Scala; be willing to switch.

jobLeads.title: Backend Engineer
jobLeads.fit: Shinjuku-ku. 5+ years backend product work; Go/Python accepted as an alternative to Java/PHP. Distributed systems/cache and willingness to learn the production stack required.

jobLeads.title: Full Stack Developer
jobLeads.fit: Backend-leaning applicants explicitly welcome. Go backend overlaps, but you must be comfortable delivering UI too. Same small team as the dedicated backend advertisement.

jobLeads.title: Senior Software Engineer — Platform (Atlas)
jobLeads.japanese: No Japanese required; conversational Japanese OR desire to learn.
jobLeads.fit: Backend-focused full-stack/platform work. Senior cloud/distributed systems and observability required. TypeScript is ideal, not a hard tenure requirement; willingness to cover other systems matters.

jobLeads.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobLeads.japanese: No Japanese required; N2+ preferred only.
jobLeads.fit: Python is an accepted foundation. Independent cloud/full-stack delivery and willingness to learn Node.js required. Only pursue if some frontend work is genuinely acceptable.

jobLeads.title: Software Engineer — Open Position (Robotics / Backend, C++)
jobLeads.fit: Tokyo/Koto-ku, on-site. C++ and/or Python; Linux, reliable systems and robotics interest needed. This is a live matching pool, not a guaranteed specific backend-team vacancy.

Major dental work and home visits
budgetAssumptions.reserveTreatment: Reserve is not another annual expense; prepaid first housing appears only once in year-one cash.

datePolicy: All external sources retain their explicitly recorded access date of 2026-11-06 Asia/Singapore (original receipts can be 2026-11-05 UTC). Undated source documents remain undated; access date is not publication date. No external lookup, vacancy refresh, salary refresh, immigration/departure-rule refresh or original-run changes during this draft. No publication date invented.
uncertainties: Not immigration or legal advice. Age, degree/major, precise completed experience anniversary, exam passes, English fluency, Python-specific tenure, cloud/distributed systems/Linux/frontend/mentoring depth, notice period, actual dependants and savings remain unconfirmed.

Six years alone does not satisfy the ordinary ten-year experience branch. Relevant degree/equivalent, qualifying Japanese vocational credentials, specified relevant study periods or exact designated IT pass require individual assessment. N4 is not a universal backend visa blocker; employer language requirements and case-specific ISA evidence remain separate.

HSP eligibility requires underlying qualifying activities and eligibility plus points and remuneration conditions. Examples are arithmetic, no employer/university/research/exam bonuses assumed. No actual HSP score or offer established.

Ten dated advertisements are six direct backend roles, three broader alternatives and one matching pool, not ten equally strong pure-backend vacancies or independent application processes. Overseas eligibility does not mean permanent remote work from the Philippines. Closed and hard language/tenure-ineligible roles were excluded.

HENNGE Python-specific floors and conditional allowances, PayPay professional AI-tool use and production-language transitions, Visual Alpha English-label discrepancy, broader frontend work and Mujin robotics/Linux/on-site matching remain consequential. Relocation caps, office policies and headcount require employer confirmation.

Salary target/floor is an editorial negotiation estimate, not guaranteed pay. Board ranges, recruiter starting base percentiles, self-reported total compensation and individual advertised compensation are different measures; Money Forward appears on both boards. TokyoDev survey respondent-count contradiction is not repeated.

Philippines-resident Filipino applicants may need designated-clinic TB screening; residence/programme exceptions and certificate timing require checking. Japanese COE/visa does not settle Philippine DMW/MWO contract verification, direct-hire exemption, current medical/orientation/insurance or actual OEC/exit-clearance route. End-to-end 2027 process remains verification required.

Housing, flights/documents, monthly allocations, reserve and late-2027 cushion are estimates, not quotes or inflation forecasts. Historical occupied-stock and student rents are context only. Temporary housing overlap, rent-linked fees, first payday and reimbursement timing can change cash need.

The sixteen-week plan, application counts, response checkpoints, language-study goals, June offer deadline and relocation buffers are recommendations, not official deadlines or hiring guarantees. Current vacancies are not held until 2027; a fixed October start can require a shifted campaign.

Original research reports isolated incognito final page checks, but this draft did not repeat live source verification or original render checks. No applications, contact, accounts, payment, publication or website-repository edits. Local source-list/evidence links are builder provenance only, not public downloads.
